text: [image: Abolishing ICE: A Call for Reform illustration] Abolishing ICE: A Call for Reform Lydia will work to abolish ICE and replace it with a fair, compassionate immigration system that upholds human dignity, stops constitutional violations, and ensures equal protection for all. Read More

[image: Defending the 2nd Amendment illustration] Defending the 2nd Amendment Unchain your right to self-defense by defending the 2nd Amendment with responsible ownership and safety measures. Read More

[image: Ending Concentration Camps and Protecting Human Rights illustration] Ending Concentration Camps and Protecting Human Rights ICE detention has passed 60,000 people while the agency cut its own inspection schedule and stripped minimum pay for detainee labor, forced labor the Constitution's narrow exception, which only covers convicted criminals, never actually permitted. Lydia will push to require minimum wage for detainee work, restore mandatory inspections, stop federal facility purchases designed to dodge state oversight, and fully fund independent Inspector General review. Read More

[image: Ending Medical Neglect in Michigan Prisons illustration] Ending Medical Neglect in Michigan Prisons Khaira Howard died in Michigan's only women's prison from a blood clot in her lungs. Black mold infests the facility. Lydia will push federal legislation establishing minimum healthcare standards under the Eighth Amendment, condition federal prison funding on independent medical decision-making, investigate DOJ enforcement of civil rights law, and support federal litigation holding states and contractors accountable. Read More

[image: Ending Qualified Immunity illustration] Ending Qualified Immunity Qualified immunity was invented by judges, not passed by Congress. Restore Section 1983 to what it actually says, and let people hold government accountable when their rights are violated. Read More

[image: Ending the Death Penalty illustration] Ending the Death Penalty Lydia opposes the death penalty. It costs more than life without parole, and the government has executed innocent people before. Read More

[image: Legalizing Cannabis & Psilocybin with Worker Safety illustration] Legalizing Cannabis & Psilocybin with Worker Safety Drug use is a health issue, not a criminal one. Lydia will push for federal legalization of cannabis and psilocybin, with full OSHA worker protections and expanded mental health treatment options, ending unjust criminal penalties for patients, practitioners, and workers alike. Read More

[image: Protecting Dreamers and DACA illustration] Protecting Dreamers and DACA Lydia will push for a permanent solution for Dreamers, protecting them from deportation, offering them a pathway to citizenship, and ensuring their futures in the United States. Read More

[image: Trans Rights in Federal Custody illustration] Trans Rights in Federal Custody Federal policy now houses trans women in men's facilities by categorical rule and has ended hormone therapy access entirely. Lydia will require housing to match completed surgical transition, restore case-by-case PREA safety review, and restore access to medically necessary hormone therapy. Read More
